Which is first and last surah as per Tarteeb-e-Nauzuli? - Al-Alaq,An-Nasar
Name the first Surah revealed in Madinah? - Al-Baqarah
How many verses are in Surah Al-Fatiha? - Seven
What kind of Surahs begin with "Ya-Ayyu-Han-Nas"? - Mostly Makki Surahs
What kind of Surahs begin with "Ya-Ayyu-Hal-Lazeena Aamanu"? - Madni Surahs
How many Surahs start with Muqatta'at (disjointed letters)? - 29
How many Surahs are named after one letter? - Three (Qaf, Sad, Noon)
Which is the longest Surah of the Holy Quran? - Al-Baqarah
Which is the shortest Surah of the Holy Quran? - Al-Kauthar
Which Surah is called the Heart of the Quran? - Yaseen (Surah no 36) * Its Ayats no 36-38 are heart of Surah Yasin
Which Surah is called Umm-ul-Quran/Umm-ul-Kitab? - Al-Fatiha
Which Surah is called the Beauty of the Quran? - Ar-Rahman
Which Surah is known as the Bride of the Quran? - Ar-Rahman
Which Surah is known as Surah of Light? - An-Nur
Which Surah is known as Surah Dawat? - Nuh
Which Surah is on the name of a Holy war? - Al-Ahzab
The Surah on the name of a metal? - Al-Hadid (meaning iron)
Surah Tawbah is also known as? - Surah Bara'at
Which Surah does not start with Bismillah? - At-Tawbah
Which Surah has Bismillah twice? - An-Naml
How many times Bismillah occurred in Quran? - 114
In which Surah is the story of Prophet Yusuf (AS)? - Surah Yusuf
Which Surah mentions Hazrat Maryam (AS) by name? - Surah Maryam
In which Surah is the incident of Ashab-e-Kahf? - Surah Al-Kahf

In which Surah is the story of Qaroon mentioned? - Surah Al-Qasas

Which Surah mentions Hazrat Dawood (AS)? - Surah Sad
Which Surah discusses Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) and Ismail (AS)? - Surah As-Saffat
Which Surah mentions Hazrat Isa (AS) most? - Surah Maryam
Which Surah mentions incident of Iblees refusing Sajda? - Surah Al-A'raf
Which Surah contains the story of Cave (Prophet ﷺ)? - Surah At-Tawbah
Which Surah mentions event of Miraj? - Surah Al-Isra
Which Surah contains Treaty of Hudaibiya? - Surah Al-Fath
Which Surah describes Battle of Badr? - Surah Al-Anfal
Which Surah describes Battle of Uhud? - Surah Al-Imran
Which Surah describes Battle of Khandaq? - Surah Al-Ahzab
Which Surah was revealed in defense of Hazrat Aisha (RA)? - Surah An-Nur
Which Surah discusses system of consultation (Shura)? - Surah Ash-Shura
Which Surahs have ayats about Hijab? - Surah Ahzab, Surah An-Nur
Which Surah contains verse of Ayat-ul-Kursi? - Al-Baqarah
Which Surah contains verse about changing Qibla? - Al-Baqarah
Which Surah contains verse about Ramadan? - Al-Baqarah
Which Surah contains verse about fasting? - Al-Baqarah (verse 183)

Which Surah discusses inheritance laws? - An-Nisa
Which Surah describes family laws? - An-Nisa
Which Surah discusses Wudhu command? - Al-Maida
Which Surah describes Hajj obligation? - Al-Hajj
Which Surah describes Soam (fasting) obligation? - Al-Baqarah
Which Surah describes punishment for drinking? - Al-Baqarah
Which Surah contains verse about Hijrah? - At-Tawbah
Which Surah describes the Day of Judgment? - Al-Qiyamah
Which Surah describes creation of man from clay? - Surah Al-Hijr
Which Surah mentions creation of heavens in six days? - Surah Al-Hadid
Which Surah discusses balance and justice (Mizan)? - Ar-Rahman
Which Surah best for protection from evil eye & magic? - Surah Al-Falaq & Surah An-Naas
Which Surah contains longest Ayah? - Al-Baqarah (verse 282)
Total Ayats in Surah Baqrah? - 286
Which Surah has the most names of Prophets? - Surah Al-An'am (18 Prophets)
How many Prophets are mentioned in Quran? - 25
Which Surah has names of two Prophets? - Surah Al-Hajj (Ibrahim AS and Ismail AS)

How many times name Ahmad is mention in Quran? - 1 time
The name which sahabi name is mentioned in Quran? - Zaid bin Harith (Surah Ahzab)
Which Surah begins with Prophet's name? - Surah Muhammad
Which Surah was revealed completely at once? - Surah Al-An'am
Which Surah mentions Ahl-e-Kitab and Munafiqeen? - Madni Surahs
Which Surah warns hypocrites? - Surah Al-Munafiqoon
Which Surahs are called Mu'awwizatain? - Surah Al-Falaq & Surah An-Naas
Which Surah repeats name of Allah five times? - Surah Al-Hajj
In which Surah name of Allah appears in every verse? - Surah Al-Mujadila
Which Surah was revealed twice? - Surah Al-Fatiha
How many Surahs are named after animals? - Al-Baqarah (The Cow), Al-An'am (The Cattle), Al-Nahl (The Bees), Al- Naml (The Ants), Al-Ankabut (The Spider), and Al-Fil (The Elephant).
How many Surahs are named after insects? - Three (Al-Nahl, Al-Naml, Al-Ankabut)

What is the literal meaning of Tauheed? - Oneness
How many types of Tauheed are there in Islam? - Three

What are the three types of Tauheed? - Tauheed al-Rububiyyah (Oneness of God), Tauheed al- Uluhiyyah (Oneness of Worship), Tauheed al-Asma wa al- Sifat (oneness in Sifat) OR Tauheed bil Zat, Bil Sifat, Bil Aamal
Which Surah is known as Surah Tauheed? - Surah Ikhlas
What is the first Kalima that affirms Tauheed? - Kalima Tayyiba (La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah)
What is the opposite of Tauheed? - Shirk
What is Shirk? - Associating partners with Allah
Which is the only unforgivable sin if not repented for? - Shirk
Which Prophet is called the father of monotheism? - Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)
Which verse in the Quran clearly defines Tauheed? - Surah Ikhlas
What is the central message of all prophets? - Tauheed
What is the testimony of faith in Islam? - Shahada
What is Iman-e-Mufassal? - The detailed declaration of faith
How many articles of faith are included in Iman-e-Mufassal? - Seven
What are the seven articles of faith in Iman-e-Mufassal? - Belief in Allah, Angels, Books, Prophets, Day of Judgment, Destiny (Taqdeer), and Life after Death
What is the difference between Iman-e-Mufassal and Iman-e- Mujmal? - Iman-e-Mufassal is a detailed faith declaration, while Iman-e-Mujmal is a brief summary

What is the text of Iman-e- Mufassal? - 7 articles of Faith 1. Faith in God; 2. Faith in His angels; 3. Faith in His revealed Books; 4. Faith in all of His messengers or Prophets; 5. Faith in the Last Day or the Day of Judgement; 6. Fairth in Taqdir; 7. Faith in the life after death.
What is the text of Iman-e- Mujmal? - Belief in Tawheed,Allah's attributes, names, commands,guidance.
Which Prophet is known for breaking idols and spreading Tauheed? - Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)
Polytheism, Monotheism, Atheism mean - Believe in multiple gods, One God, No good respectively.
What is the literal meaning of Risalat? - Message or Prophethood
What is the belief in Risalat called in Arabic? - Iman bil-Risalat
How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran? - 25
Who was the first prophet of Islam? - Prophet Adam (A.S.)
Who was the last prophet of Islam? - Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
What is the title of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) that signifies the finality of Prophethood? - Khatam-un-Nabiyeen
In which Surah is Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) called "Khatam-un-Nabiyeen"? - Surah Al-Ahzab
What is the primary duty of a prophet? - To convey Allah's message (Wahi) to the people
How many Rasools (Messengers) were sent by Allah? - 313
How many total prophets were sent by Allah? - 124,000
Which prophet is called Khalilullah (Friend of Allah)? - Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)
Which prophet is called Kalimullah (Spoke to Allah directly)? - Prophet Musa (A.S.)
Which prophet is Ruhullah (Spirit of Allah)? - Prophet Isa (A.S.)
Which prophet is Safiullah (Chosen by Allah)? - Prophet Adam (A.S.)
Which prophet is Zabiullah (Sacrificed for Allah)? - Prophet Ismail (A.S.)
Which prophet is Najiyullah (Saved by Allah)? - Prophet Nuh (A.S.)
Who was the only prophet to be born without a father? - Prophet Isa (A.S.)
Which prophet was swallowed by a fish? - Prophet Yunus (A.S.)
Which prophet built the Ark to save his followers? - Prophet Nuh (A.S.)
Which prophet was given the ability to cure the blind and sick by Allah? - Prophet Isa (A.S.)
Which prophet could communicate with animals and jinn? - Prophet Sulaiman (A.S.)
Which prophet could understand the language of birds? - Prophet Sulaiman (A.S.)
Which prophet was swallowed by a whale for 40 days? - Prophet Yunus (A.S.)
Which prophet was thrown into fire but remained unharmed? - Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)
Which prophet was given the miracle of splitting the sea? - Prophet Musa (A.S.)
Which prophet was known for his patience in trials? - Prophet Ayyub (A.S.)
Which prophet was the father of Bani Israel? - Prophet Yaqub (A.S.)
Which prophet was raised to the heavens without death? - Prophet Isa (A.S.)
Who were the Ulul Azm prophets (Prophets of strong determination)? - Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, Muhammad (Peace be upon them all)
What was the first book revealed to mankind? - Suhuf-e-Ibrahim
How many divine books were revealed by Allah? - 4 major books and some scriptures
Which book was revealed to Prophet Musa (A.S.)? - Torah
Which book was revealed to Prophet Dawood (A.S.)? - Zaboor
Which book was revealed to Prophet Isa (A.S.)? - Injeel
Which book was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)? - Quran
What is the final and complete book of guidance? - Quran
Who was the first prophet given a revealed book? - Prophet Musa (A.S.)
What is the primary belief regarding all prophets in Islam? - All prophets preached Tauheed (Oneness of Allah)
What is the difference between a Nabi and a Rasool? - A Nabi receives revelation, but a Rasool is given a new Shariah (law) and book
Who is the best of all prophets in Islam? - Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
Which nation was destroyed by a flood? - Qoum-e-Nuh
What was the crime of Qoum-e-Nuh? - Idol worship, disobedience to Allah's commands
Which nation was destroyed by a strong windstorm? - Qoum-e-Aad (Prophet Hud's people)
What was the crime of Qoum-e-Aad? - Arrogance, denial of the prophet, oppression
Which nation was destroyed by an earthquake and loud blast? - Qoum-e-Samood (Prophet Saleh's people)
What was the crime of Qoum-e-Samood? - Disobedience, challenging Allah's signs, killing the she-camel
Which nation was punished by stones of baked clay from the sky? - Qoum-e-Lut (Prophet Lut's people)
What was the crime of Qoum-e-Lut? - Homosexuality, immorality, rejecting the prophet's warnings
Which nation was destroyed by a rain of stones and reversal of land? - People of Prophet Lut (A.S.)
Which prophet's people were destroyed by locusts, lice, frogs, and blood? - Pharaoh's (Firaun) nation (Prophet Musa's people - Egyptians)
What was the crime of Pharaoh's nation? - Denial of Allah, oppression, enslaving Bani Israel
Which nation was given the punishment of a severe earthquake? - Qoum-e-Madyan (People of Prophet Shuaib A.S.)
What was the crime of Qoum-e-Madyan? - Fraud in business, dishonesty in trade, rejecting the prophet
Which prophet was sent to the people of Nineveh? - Prophet Yunus (A.S.)
Which prophet is mentioned most in the Quran? - Prophet Musa (A.S.)
Which prophet was given the title "Seal of the Prophets"? - Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
Which prophets were also kings? - Prophet Dawood (A.S.) & Prophet Sulaiman (A.S.)
Which prophet's throne (Takht) would fly in the air? - Prophet Sulaiman (A.S.)
How many days did Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) remain in the well? - 3 days
How many brothers did Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) have? - 11 brothers
Who was the father of Prophet Yusuf (A.S.)? - Prophet Yaqub (A.S.)
Which prophet was referred to as "Son of God" by the Jews? - Prophet Uzair (A.S.)
What was Prophet Dawood (A.S.) known for? - He was a king, warrior, and psalmist (Zaboor was revealed to him).
What were Prophet Sulaiman (A.S.)'s major miracles? - Control over Jinns, animals, wind, and ability to understand the language of birds.
What was the relation between Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) and Prophet Ismail (A.S.)? - Father & Son
What was the relation between Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) and Prophet Ishaq (A.S.)? - Father & Son
What was the relation between Prophet Yaqub (A.S.) and Prophet Yusuf (A.S.)? - Father & Son
What was the relation between Prophet Musa (A.S.) and Prophet Haroon (A.S.)? - Brothers
What was the profession of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)? - Trader & Shepherd
What was the profession of Prophet Dawood (A.S.)? - Blacksmith
What was the profession of Prophet Nuh (A.S.)? - Carpenter
What was the profession of Prophet Idris (A.S.)? - Tailor
What was the profession of Prophet Musa (A.S.) for a time? - Shepherd
What was the profession of Prophet Zakariya (A.S.)? - Carpenter
How many angels are mentioned by name in the Quran? - Four
Who is the angel responsible for delivering revelations to prophets? - Jibril (Gabriel)
Which angel is responsible for the blowing of the trumpet on the Day of Judgment? - Israfil
Who is known as the Angel of Death? - Azrael
Which angel is responsible for controlling rain and sustenance? - Mikail (Michael)
What is the role of Raqib? - Recording good deeds
What is the role of Atid? - Recording bad deeds
What are the names of the two angels who question the dead in the grave? - Munkar and Nakir
Which two angels are known as the Kiraman Katibin? - Raqib and Atid
How many wings does Angel Jibril have, according to Islamic tradition? - 600
Which angel brings punishment upon sinful nations? - Jibril
Which angel is mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah along with Jibril? - Mikail
Who is the guardian of Hell (Jahannam)? - Malik
How many angels guard Hell (Jahannam)? - 19
Who is the chief angel of Heaven (Jannah)? - Ridwan
Who is responsible for welcoming the believers into Paradise? - Ridwan
Who are Saiq and Shaiq? - Angels who bring people towards Jannah or Jahannam
Who is known as "Ruhul Quds" (The Holy Spirit)? - Jibril
In which Surah is Jibril referred to as Ruhul Quds? - Surah Al-Nahl
Which angel will escort people to their final destinations on the Day of Judgment? - Saiq and Shaiq
Who is Iblees? - A jin, made of fire
Angles are made up of? - Light (Noor)
To which Prophet was Taurat revealed? - Hazrat Musa (AS)
In which language was Taurat 2 revealed? - Hebrew
Where was Taurat revealed? - Mount Sinai (Koh-e-Toor)
What was the main message of Taurat? - Laws and commandments
To which Prophet was Zabur revealed? - Hazrat Dawood (AS)
In which language was Zabur 2 revealed? - Syriac/Aramaic
Where was Zabur revealed? - Jerusalem
What is Zabur mainly composed of? - Hymns & praises of Allah
To which Prophet was Injil revealed? - Hazrat Isa (AS)
In which language was Injil 2 revealed? - Syriac/Aramaic
Where was Injil revealed? - Jerusalem
What was the main message of Injil? - Love, mercy, and monotheism
To which Prophet was the Quran revealed? - Hazrat Muhammad (SAW)
In which language was the Quran revealed? - Arabic
Over how many years was the Quran revealed? - 23 years
Where was the first revelation of the Quran? - Cave Hira (Ghar-e-Hira)
Which was the first revealed verse of the Quran? - Surah Al-Alaq
Which was the last revealed verse of the Quran? - Surah An-Nasr
Where is the Quran preserved? - Lauh-e-Mahfuz (Preserved Tablet)
How many major Holy Books were revealed? - 4
How many total Suhuf (Scrolls) were revealed? - 100
Apart from the 4 books, which other scriptures were revealed? - Suhuf-e-Ibrahim, Suhuf-e- Musa
What is Akhirat in Islam? - The belief in life after death, where all humans will be judged by Allah.
What are the two destinations after judgment? - Jannah (Paradise) for the righteous and Jahannam (Hell) for the sinners.
What is the Islamic term for the Day of Judgment? - Yawm al-Qiyamah (ةمايقلا موي) , Youm al Hasra, Youm al Akhira, etc
What is Barzakh? - The intermediate state between death and resurrection.
What is the bridge over Hell? - As-Sirat (The Bridge) - all people must cross it; only the righteous will pass safely.
What are the scales of judgment? - Mizan - the weighing scale to measure good and bad deeds.
Where are souls (roh) of believers and disbelievers are held? - Sijjin (7th earth) for sinners and Illiyyin (7th Sky) (for righteous).
Who will be the first person to enter Jannah? - Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
What is Intercession (Shafa'ah)? - Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) will intercede for his Ummah on the Day of Judgment.
What are the highest and lowest levels 0 of Jannah? - Highest: Jannat-ul-Firdous Lowest: Jannat-ul- Mawa
What is the lowest level of Jahannam? - Hutamah (Hellfire for hypocrites and disbelievers).
What are the names of Hell in Islam? - Jahannam, Hutamah, Saqar, Laza, Hawiyah, Sa'eer, Jaheem.
What is the test of Munkar and 13 Nakir? - Two angels question the dead about their faith in the grave.
What is the significance of the 14 Trumpet (Soor)? - It will be blown twice: first to end the world, second for resurrection.
Who is the founder of Hinduism? - No single founder (Ancient tradition)
Major holy books of Hinduism? - Vedas, Bhagavad Gita, Ramayana, Mahabharata
Major religious sites? - Varanasi , Ayodhya (Ram Janmabhoomi),
Major gods in Hinduism? - Brahma (Creator), Vishnu (Preserver), Shiva (Destroyer)
Other key concepts? - Karma, Dharma, Moksha, Reincarnation
Who is the founder of Confucianism? - Confucius (Kong Fuzi)
Major holy books of Confucianism? - Analects, Five Classics, Four Books
Major religious sites? - Temple of Confucius (Qufu, China)
Other key concepts? - Filial Piety, Ethical Conduct, Social Harmony
Who is the founder of 1 Buddhism? - Siddhartha Gautama (Buddha)
Major holy books of 2 Buddhism? - Tripitaka (Three Baskets)
Major religious sites? - (Nepal - Birthplace), Bodh Gaya (India - Enlightenment), (India - First Sermon)
Other key concepts? - Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path, Nirvana
Who is the founder of Sikhism? - Guru Nanak Dev Ji
Who was the last Guru of Sikhism? - Guru Gobind Singh Ji (10th Guru)
Which Guru was persecuted and escaped through a river? - Guru Gobind Singh Ji (crossed Sirsa River while escaping Mughal forces during Aurangzeb Rule)
What is the holy book of Sikhism? - Guru Granth Sahib
Major religious sites in India? - Golden Temple (Amritsar)
Major religious sites in Pakistan? - Nankana Sahib (Birthplace of Guru Nanak), Kartarpur Sahib (Gurdwara Darbar Sahib), Panja Sahib (Hassan Abdal), Dera Sahib (Lahore)
Major beliefs of Sikhism? - One God (Ik Onkar), Equality, Seva (Selfless Service)
What did Guru Gobind Singh establish? - Khalsa (1699) - warrior-saint community
Which Guru compiled the Guru Granth Sahib? - Guru Arjan Dev Ji (5th Guru)
Which Guru was executed for protecting Hinduism? - Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji (9th Guru). Executed by Aurangzeb
What are the Five Ks of Sikhism? - Kesh (Uncut Hair), Kara (Steel Bracelet), Kanga (Wooden Comb), Kachera (Cotton Undergarment), Kirpan (Sword)
Torah - Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy (Collectively called Pentateuch)
Nevi'im - Prophets (Major & Minor)
Ketuvim - Psalms, Proverbs, Chronicles
What is the Trinity in 1 Christianity? - The belief that God exists as three persons: Father, Son (Jesus Christ), and Holy Spirit, yet is one God.
What are the three persons 2 of the Trinity? - 1. God the Father (Creator) 2. God the Son (Jesus Christ) (Savior) 3. God the Holy Spirit (Guide and Comforter)
Old Testament - Torah (Pentateuch), Historical Books, Psalms, Prophets
New Testament - Gospels, Acts , Revelation
Literal meaning of Salah? - Connection, prayer
Namaz-e-Khasoof is related to? - Lunar Eclipse
Namaz-e-Kusoof is related to? - Solar Eclipse
Namaz-e-Istasqa is related to? - Rain
How many Fardh are there in Namaz? - 6
Namaz-e-Eid is? - Wajib
Namaz was made obligatory during Miraj in which year of Nabvi? - 10th
How many daily Salah were initially prescribed before being reduced to 5? - 50
A Namaz with six additional Takbeers? - Eid
How many Takbeers in Namaz-e-Janaza? - 4
How many times Namaz is commanded in the Quran? - 700
First Jumma Prayer offered in? - 1 A.H
First Eid Prayer offered in? - 2 A.H
When was Qiblah changed from Masjid Al-Aqsa to Khana Kaaba? - 2 A.H
How many Faraz are in Wudu? - 4
How many Sunnah are in Wudu? - 8
How many Faraz are in Ghusl? - 3
How many Sunnah are in Ghusl? - 5
Where did Salat Jumma become Faraz? - Madina
Meaning of Wudu? - Purification
Which Kalimah is recited after Wudu? - Kalimah-e-Shahadat
Surah mentioning the procedure of Wudu? - Al-Maidah
How many types of Salat? - 5 (Fardh, Wajib, Sunnah, Nafl, Janaza)
Salat-e-Janaza is? - Farz-e-Kifayah
Which Salat is offered standing in odd-numbered lines? - Janaza
Nafl Salat offered after midnight till dawn? - Tahajjud
Nafl Salat offered after sunrise till one-fourth of the day? - Ishraq
Nafl Salat offered till half of the day? - Chasht
Nafl Salat offered after Maghrib? - Awabeen
Which prayer is offered at the time of fear and danger? - Salat-ul-Khauf
Which Surah is recommended to be recited in Fajr? - Surah Al-Kafirun & Surah Al- Ikhlas
Which prayer is performed before starting a journey? - Salat-ul-Safar
Which prayer is performed after returning from a journey? - Salat-ul-Wusool
In which year was fasting made obligatory? - 2 A.H.
What is the literal meaning of Roza (Sawm)? - To abstain (from eating, drinking, and other acts)
What is the door of Jannah for fasting people? - Bab-ur-Rayyan
What is Kaffarah (expiation) for breaking a fast intentionally? - Fast for 60 days or feed 60 poor people
What is the punishment for intentionally breaking a fast? - Kaffarah (60 continuous fasts or feeding 60 poor people)
Who is exempted from fasting in Ramadan? - Sick, travelers, pregnant women, elderly, children, menstruating women
In which Surah is fasting made obligatory? - Surah Al-Baqarah
What is the reward of fasting according to Hadith? - Allah Himself will reward it (Hadith: Bukhari, Muslim)
Fasting is between Rozadar and whom? - Allah
Which Prophet fasted for 40 days in the desert? - Prophet Isa (AS)
What is the significance of the 13th, 14th, and 15th fast of each Islamic month? - Ayyaam-ul-Beed (White Days), Sunnah fasting

What is a Hadith (ثیدح)? - A report of the sayings, actions, or approvals of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What are the two main components of a Hadith (ثیدح)? - Sanad (دنس) - chain of narrators, and Matn (نتم) - text of the Hadith.
What is Hadith Qudsi ( ثیدح یسدق)? - A Hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) conveys words from Allah but not as part of the Quran.
What is Hadith e Qauli ( ثیدح یلوق)? - A Hadith that contains the spoken words or sayings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith e Fili ( ثیدح یلعف)? - A Hadith that describes the actions or practices of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith Nabawi (یوبن ثیدح)? - A Hadith that includes the sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Sahih Hadith (ثیدح حیحص)? - A Hadith that is authentic, having a strong chain of narrators with no defects.
What is a Da'if Hadith (ثیدح فیعض)? - A weak Hadith due to a missing or unreliable narrator.
What is a Hasan Hadith (ثیدح نسح)? - A Hadith that is slightly weaker than Sahih but still acceptable.
What is a Mawdu Hadith (ثیدح عوضوم)? - A fabricated Hadith falsely attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mutawatir Hadith (ثیدح رتاوتم)? - A Hadith reported by a large number of narrators in every generation, making fabrication impossible.
What is an Ahad Hadith (ثیدح داحآ)? - A Hadith reported by a limited number of narrators and not reaching the level of Mutawatir.
What are the three types of Ahad Hadith (ثیدح داحآ)? - Gharib (بیرغ), Aziz (زیزع), Mashhur (روہشم).
What is a Gharib Hadith (ثیدح بیرغ)? - A Hadith narrated by a single person at some stage of its chain.
What is an Aziz Hadith (ثیدح زیزع)? - A Hadith narrated by at least two narrators at all levels of the chain.
What is a Mashhur Hadith (ثیدح روہشم)? - A Hadith initially narrated by a few people but later widely reported.
What is a Taqreeri Hadith (یریرقت ثیدح)? - A Hadith where someone spoke or acted in front of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and he remained silent, indicating approval.
What is a Hadith Ijmali (یلامجا ثیدح)? - A Hadith that is narrated by all four Imams (Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad).
What is a Hadith Ahle Madina (ہنیدم لہا ثیدح)? - A Hadith narrated primarily by the people of Madina based on their practices.
What is a Hadith Ahle Makkah (ہکم لہا ثیدح)? - A Hadith narrated primarily by the people of Makkah based on their traditions.
What is a Marfu Hadith (عوفرم ثیدح)? - A Hadith directly attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mauquf Hadith (فوقوم ثیدح)? - A Hadith that stops at a Companion (Sahabi) and is not directly attributed to the Prophet (PBUH).
What is a Maqtu Hadith (عوطقم ثیدح)? - A Hadith that stops at a Tabi'i (یعبات) (Successor of a Companion).
What is a Musnad Hadith (دنسم ثیدح)? - A Hadith with a continuous chain reaching Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mursal Hadith (لسرم ثیدح)? - A Hadith where a Tabi'i (یعبات) directly attributes a statement to the Prophet (PBUH), skipping the Companion.
What is a Mudallas Hadith (سلدم ثیدح)? - A Hadith where a narrator hides or skips a weak narrator in the chain to make it appear authentic.
What is Ijma 1 (عامجا)? - Consensus of Islamic scholars on a religious ruling after the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is considered a source of Islamic law.
What is Ijtihad 2 (داہتجا)? - Independent reasoning by a qualified scholar to derive Islamic rulings when there is no clear text in Quran or Hadith.
What is Qiyas 3 (سایق)? - Analogical reasoning where a ruling is derived for a new issue by comparing it with an existing ruling in Quran, Hadith, or Ijma.

Parda (Veil) made mandatory; 4 AH; Revealed in Surah Al-Ahzab
Interest (Riba) prohibited; 9 AH; Strictly forbidden
Hajj made Farz; 9 AH; Last obligation revealed
Jizyah imposed on non- Muslims; 9 AH; Tax on non-Muslim subjects
Talha ibn Ubaydullah (RA) - Known as "Talha the Generous" Defender of Prophet ﷺ in Uhud Died in Battle of Jamal (656 CE).
Zubair ibn Al-Awwam (RA) - First to draw sword for Islam Cousin of Prophet ﷺ (Son of Prophets Phupo Safiyyah) Killed in Battle of Jamal.
Abdur Rahman ibn Awf (RA) - Wealthiest Sahabi Funded Islamic battles Bought land for Masjid-e-Nabwi expansion.
Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) - Led Muslims in Battle of Qadisiyyah (636 AD vs Sassanids) First to shoot an arrow in Islam.
Sa'id ibn Zayd (RA) - One of the first Muslims Fought in major battles.
Abu Ubaidah ibn Jarrah (RA) - Commander in conquests of Syria Given the title "Ameen Ul Ummah" by Prophet ﷺ.
Bilal ibn Rabah (RA) - First Muazzin of Islam Freed from slavery by Abu Bakr (RA) Close to Prophet ﷺ.
Khalid ibn Al-Walid (RA) - Known as "Sword of Allah" (Saifullah) Won over 100 battles Led Muslims in Battle of Yarmouk (636 AD vs Bazyntines)
Salman Al-Farsi (RA) - Suggested trench strategy in Battle of Khandaq Persian companion Command over various languages.
Muadh ibn Jabal (RA) - Sent as governor to Yemen
Ja'far ibn Abi Talib (RA) - Led Muslims in Abyssinia Brother of Ali (RA) Martyred in Battle of Mutah (8AH vs Byzantines).
Ammar ibn Yasir (RA) - First Muslim family tortured Martyred in Battle of Siffin.
Abdullah ibn Masood (RA) - First to recite Quran publicly in Makkah Expert in Quranic recitation & Tafsir.
Hudhaifa ibn Al-Yaman (RA) - Holder of Prophet's secrets Knew names of all Munafiqeen (Hypocrites).
Abu Huraira (RA) - Narrated most Hadiths (5,374)
Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib (RA) - Custodian of Zamzam (Known as Saqi e Zamzam) Ancestor of Abbasid Caliphate
Abbas ibn Ali (RA) - Alamdar-e-Karbala Martyr of Karbala & symbol of bravery & loyalty
Abdullah ibn e Abbas (RA) - Considered one of Earliest Mufti of Islam Lineage of Abbasids is traced through him
Fatima bint Muhammad (RA) - Daughter of Prophetﷺ Called Sayyidat-un-Nisa, Married to Ali (RA).
